services.name: Lounge Rentals
services.desc: Metro Theatre offers rentals for our theatre, lounge, scene shop, and rehearsal hall, as well as our large costume and properties inventory. Read here to find out more if Metro is the right fit for you! Just a few blocks away, our fully equipped scene shop and rehearsal hall at Oak St. & Marine Drive is also available for rental. It includes a large inventory of props and costumes, which are available for hire. The theatre is available for rentals daily from mid-June to mid-August, with limited availability during the rest of the year depending on our production schedule. services.name: Curling
services.desc: The New Canadian Curling Club is presented by arrangement with Playwrights Canada Press. Warm, witty, and unmistakably Canadian, The Real Canadian Curling Club is a heartfelt comedy set in a small-town curling rink where four unlikely teammates are thrown together for a bonspiel. As they navigate cultural differences, clashing personalities, and the quirks of the game, what begins as a rocky partnership transforms into an unexpected bond. Filled with sharp humour and genuine warmth, this charming play celebrates community, connection, and the spirit of Canada-on and off the ice. blurb: The Royal Flush Fund is Metro Theatre’s campaign to invest in the future of our beloved venue. Funds raised will support essential building upgrades including expanded and modernized washrooms, improved accessibility, updated fire safety systems, and a new HVAC system to keep patrons comfortable year-round.
